title: Prime chains in a filtered ring colimit occur at one stage
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], let $R:I\to\mathrm{CRing}$ be a diagram of commutative rings, and let $S=\varinjlim_I R$ be its colimit, with coprojections $\iota_i:R(i)\to S$. For every finite strictly increasing chain $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_n$ of prime ideals in $S$ there is an object $i$ of $I$ such that the contractions $\iota_i^{-1}(\mathfrak p_0)\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\iota_i^{-1}(\mathfrak p_n)$ form a strictly increasing chain of prime ideals in $R(i)$. Consequently $\dim S\leq\sup_{i\in I}\dim R(i)$, for Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LK, proof: contraction of a finite prime chain in R^{sh}=colim R_i to a sufficiently large étale stage

proof.text: Let $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_n$ be a finite chain of primes in $S$. For each $j<n$ choose $x_j\in\mathfrak p_{j+1}\setminus\mathfrak p_j$. By [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise], each $x_j$ is represented by an element at some stage. Filteredness gives one stage $R_i$ receiving all these finitely many stages. The contractions $\mathfrak p_j\cap R_i:=\iota_i^{-1}(\mathfrak p_j)$ are prime (preimages of primes under a ring map) and form an increasing chain, and the chosen representative of $x_j$ lies in $\mathfrak p_{j+1}\cap R_i$ but not in $\mathfrak p_j\cap R_i$; hence the chain is strictly increasing at $R_i$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LK, proof of the converse inequality: contraction of a finite prime chain in a directed colimit to a sufficiently large stage

proof.text: Every finite chain in $S$ therefore has length at most $\dim R_i$ for some stage $i$, and so at most $\sup_i\dim R_i$. Taking the supremum over all finite prime chains gives $\dim S\leq\sup_i\dim R_i$ by the definition of Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_prime_chain_and_dimension {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) : (∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ideal (colimit R : CommRingCat.{u})), (∀ j, (p j).IsPrime) → StrictMono p → ∃ i : I, (∀ j, (Ideal.comap (colimit.ι R i).hom (p j)).IsPrime) ∧ StrictMono (fun j ↦ Ideal.comap (colimit.ι R i).hom (p j))) ∧ ringKrullDim (colimit R : CommRingCat.{u}) ≤ ⨆ i : I, ringKrullDim (R.obj i)
